name: THE GRANDMOTHER
attacks: THE STICK THROW (listenTell->throwTell/thrown, only if caught making noise during LISTEN)
window: no damage gate/multiplier at all (hurtGate is a single early-return: 'nothing there to hit' while e.mode==='vanish' or alpha<0.35). No bonus-damage state exists.
a11why: hurtEnemy0 only excludes hits while she is invisible (vanish/low alpha); every other moment, including mid-attack, takes ordinary damage with no multiplier. There is no caused or timed opening to speak of because none is needed. src/main.js:5311
a10: Phase 2 (hp<=half, src/main.js:15646) only tightens her clock: sweep/feel/fire/listen/teleport cooldowns all shrink and she throws two fireballs instead of one (src/main.js:15714) — same attack set, just faster and denser.

name: THE DIVING BELL
a11why: vent() (src/main.js:14411) is called automatically at the end of every single attack (claw/slam/pressure/scuttle, and also on hitting an arena wall while scuttling) with no player action required to trigger it - it is exactly the rules' own example of 'a rest after every attack.'
a10: Phase 2 (hp<=half, generic ENRAGED trigger, src/main.js:5536) only raises idle/charge speed (34->48, 230->270 px/s, src/main.js:14416,14433) - no new attack, no new opening.

name: THE DROWNED KING
window: e.open>0 -> dmg*1.35; plunge while P.swim -> dmg*0.5 (a plunge finds nothing on a swimming king). src/main.js:5357-5358
a11why: e.open is set by 5 different post-attack states: STUNNED after a ram (src/main.js:14660, always fires on any wall/pillar hit, longer if it is stone - not something the player must specifically engineer), MIRED after a dive lands on the floor (src/main.js:14661, his dive always ends on the floor), REEL after a whirl or a gulp finishes (14631, 14645 - runs out on its own clock). Only THE ANCHOR gives a genuinely caused opening: blocking it fouls the chain and opens him (src/main.js:14607-14609, 'blocked' result only). So one of six paths to e.open is caused (guard the anchor); the other five are automatic run-outs of an attack, closer to 'waited'.
a10: Phase 2 ('HE LETS GO OF THE CHAIN', src/main.js:14519) speeds up swimming/orbit/attack cooldowns across the board, adds THE DEBT to his rotation, widens the Maelstrom's reach (200->230), and shortens his STUNNED/MIRED openings (2s->1.7s stone, 1.6s->1.2s mired) - so the fight gets harder to punish even as it gets more dangerous.

name: THE KEEPER OF THE VAULT
window: hurtGate has no entry for bellguard at all - no damage multiplier, no immunity, no bonus state anywhere in hurtEnemy0.
a11why: No gate exists; every hit lands at full, unmodified damage at any time. src/main.js hurtEnemy0 (~5303-5420) has zero bellguard-specific lines.
a10: no phases (phaseLines:0, no hp/2 entry in the generic ENRAGED list at src/main.js:5536, no phase field touched in updateBellguard).
bugs: A1 VIOLATION: only 2 told attacks (hook, knell), well under the 4-minimum. The bestiary text ('He rests after ringing, and that is the time to close') implies a rest-window opening, but no such window carries any damage bonus in code - closing on him during rest is only safe, not rewarded, unlike every other boss in this batch.

name: THE KRAKEN
window: The body itself is never hit directly (krakenHurt returns false unless e.passThrough); damage only lands through an arm or feeler, at 1x-2.5x depending on arm state (down/stun 1.5x, KNELLED 2.5x, PINNED 2.5x, LOOK 1.35x). src/main.js:11178-11213, called from :5332
a11why: The biggest multipliers are explicitly CAUSED: ringing the old bell KNELLS him (krakenKnell, src/main.js:11219, an environmental prop the player must strike) and standing behind a waystone PINS his spear arm (both give 2.5x and are the bestiary's headline tactics, src/main.js:3818). But every ordinary attack also leaves its arm briefly hittable afterward in a 'down'/'stun' state at 1.5x with no player setup required (src/main.js:11186) - so baseline damage is available on a simple automatic cooldown, while the big multipliers require the caused, environmental actions.
a10: This boss is NOT a simple hp<=half two-phase fight: it runs 3 authored STAGES gated on severing all four/two arms (src/main.js:11457-11458), not on an hp threshold. Stage 2 moves the fight out to sea with cargo attacks (crates/geysers/jets) and returns 2 quicker arms; stage 3 (desp, hp<14%) speeds every timer by 25%. Standard A10 hp/2 check does not apply here by design.
bugs: none found; note the phase mechanism deliberately does not follow the generic hp/2 pattern used by every other boss in this batch

name: THE TIDE REAVER
window: reaverTake: DISARMED/FETCH/WRENCH -> dmg*2, else dmg unchanged. src/tide-reaver.js:25-27, called from src/main.js:5286
a11why: The only way he opens is a missed CAST: the file's own header comment names it - 'THE OPENING IS YOURS... get OVER or OUT of the cast's line. A cast that finds no one runs on into the arena wall and sticks there... he is DISARMED, every blow counts twice.' Guarding or eating the cast closes nothing ('opens nothing', src/tide-reaver.js:12). This is a textbook caused opening. src/tide-reaver.js:10-12, 62-63
a10: Phase 2 (hp<=half, src/tide-reaver.js:48, 'THE TIDE TURNS WITH HIM') adds THE UNDERTOW to his rotation, lets a Low Rake chain straight into a wave (rakeWave), and shortens his rest between attacks (cd 1.15 -> cdP2 0.85).

name: THE PALADIN
window: not e.open>0 -> hit is a no-op (return, plays a 'WARDED' clank, no damage at all); e.open>0 -> dmg*2. src/main.js:5349-5352, 5355
a11why: The comment says it outright: 'Only the window his own blow opens - a parry, or a dodge taken through it - lets anything at all reach him.' BREAK() (src/main.js:13833) is only called from palOpened(res), which checks the player answered his cut/thrust exactly on the beat (parry timing / dodge-through / held block within PAL_BEAT). This is the cleanest possible example of a caused opening in the whole batch, and it is also the only source of ANY damage - not just bonus damage. src/main.js:5347-5352, 13815-13816
a10: Phase 2 ('HIS OATH IS SWORN', src/main.js:13832) adds two new unblockable attacks (THE OATH, a low sweep, and RADIANCE, three marked columns), and speeds up his stalk and his sword timings (PAL arrays index into phase). Both new attacks explicitly cannot be blocked and both still leave the ward open afterward.

name: THE SERJEANT OF THE LISTS
window: mounted & not blown/rear/reel -> dmg*0.6 (barding); mounted & e.open>0 -> dmg*1.5; unmounted default is unmultiplied (1x). src/main.js:5356
a11why: The only ways to raise his damage above baseline are player actions: blocking the charge either rears the horse (e.open=1.5, src/main.js:13979) or unhorses him outright (e.open=1.3, unhorse(), :13960-13961) - both require guarding on time. Riding him into the wall also opens him (:13960 via r.hitX) but that is a byproduct of the arena's ends, not really a repeatable player tactic. src/main.js:13979, 13960
a10: Phase 2 (hp<hp0/2, src/main.js:13958, 'HE LOWERS HIS VISOR') only raises charge speed (215->235 px/s when mini). No new attack, no new opening.
bugs: A1 VIOLATION: only 3 told attacks (charge, swipe, cut) - under the 4-minimum. Also a likely bug: successfully parrying a mounted swipe or an on-foot cut sets e.mode='reel' and prints 'OPEN' (src/main.js:13987, 14000), but never sets e.open - so unlike REAR/UNHORSED/BLOWN, this 'OPEN' state carries no damage bonus (it only escapes the -0.6x barding penalty back to 1x, since e.mode==='reel' is excluded from the barding multiplier's condition). The text promises an opening the code does not pay off the same way the other three do.

name: THE BURIED PRINCE
window: buried -> dmg*2; reel -> dmg*1.5; bareheaded (e.bare>0) -> dmg*1.5 (multipliers stack); shrouded (<half lamps lit) -> dmg*0.35; lit (all lamps) -> dmg*1.25; sunk (underground) -> immune (returns null). src/main.js:13309-13317
a11: mixed, caused gives the biggest windows
a11why: The two biggest multipliers are player-caused: BURIED (2x) only happens when the player cuts a timber set while he stands under it, calling princeBuried() from outside this function ('CUT A TIMBER SET WHILE HE STANDS UNDER IT: THE ROOF BURIES HIM', src/main.js:13361); REEL (1.5x) only happens on a successful block of the Royal Cut (src/main.js:13380). BAREHEADED (also 1.5x) is instead an automatic byproduct of his own crown-throw attack landing (e.bare=1 set unconditionally in crownTell, src/main.js:13409) and lasts until the crown flies back - a timed window, not one the player causes. The LIT/SHROUDED multiplier depends on how many tomb lamps are burning, itself shaped by his own SNUFF attack and by player relighting, so it's environmental rather than cleanly caused or waited.
a10: Phase 2 (generic ENRAGED at hp<=half, src/main.js:5536, and his own tell at 13369) adds SNUFF THE LAMPS (darkens the tomb and knocks the player down), lets THE ROYAL CUT double-hit (e.cuts=2), and shortens essentially every cooldown and tell.

name: THE SCARECROW KING
window: e.open>0 -> dmg*2 (or dmg*2.2 for the specific ablaze-triggering blow); 'rebuild'/'lightTell'/'poleLeap' (transformation windups) -> immune (return false); default -> dmg*0.45 (straw takes little). src/main.js:10121-10128
a11why: Every source of e.open is an environmental action the player takes, matching the bestiary text exactly: cutting the crop pole he is lashed to drops him into SLUMP (src/main.js:9835, e.open=4); striking the vine-held trough while he stands by it TANGLES him (src/main.js:9806, e.open=4.2); and landing a heavy/dash/plunge blow on him while he carries the lit lantern in stage III knocks it into his own straw and sets him ABLAZE (src/main.js:10123-10124, e.open=5, gated on P.heavySwing/dashAtk/plunge). None of these fire on a timer - the pole, the trough and the lantern are all things the player must specifically hit.
a10: This is a 3-STAGE boss, not a simple hp/2 phase: he rebuilds into a bigger form under 66% hp (stage 2, gains BALE and SLAM, grows to h:72, src/main.js:10084-10091) and lights his lantern under 33% hp (stage 3, gains LANTERN THROW and LEAP, sets the field on fire, src/main.js:10098-10102). Standard A10 hp/2 check does not apply.
bugs: Note: stage I alone only offers 3 distinct told attacks (sweep, call, fork) - the 4-minimum is only met once stage II's bale/slam appear. Not a violation of the letter of A1 (the fight overall has 7), but the opening third of the fight is thinner than the rest.

name: THE HEADLESS PLOUGHMAN
a11why: e.open is only ever set in the 'stuck' state (src/main.js:10015, e.open=e.modeT), which is reached automatically at the end of every single CHARGE - he always drives the length of the field and always sticks at the arena edge (or a wall) once modeT runs out or he hits something; the player does not need to lure him anywhere specific. The bestiary text ('at the end of the furrow the share sticks: cut him then') describes this as if it were earned, but mechanically it is the guaranteed, timed conclusion of every charge, not a player-caused event.
a10: Phase 2 (hp<half, src/main.js:10008) shortens the charge windup (0.9->0.75) and the stuck recovery (2.6->1.9), doubles the head throw (2 heads at once), and gives a 45% chance to charge again immediately after wrenching free instead of resting.
bugs: A1 VIOLATION: only 3 told attacks (charge, goad, head throw) - under the 4-minimum.
